# Weight Balance

> Physician-led telehealth from WT Balance Inc PC, doing business as Weight Balance. A provider evaluation is required before any prescription. There is no membership fee.

Medical Director: Dr. Aloysius Fobi, M.D. Pharmacy partner: Texas Star Pharmacy, a licensed 503A compounding pharmacy. States served: Arizona, California, Colorado, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Nevada, New Mexico, Oregon, Texas, Washington.

Compounded medications are not FDA-approved.
